inventory_evidence.name: Supplier invoice mailbox intake
inventory_evidence.description: Reads shared-mailbox invoices, checks required fields, and places complete submissions in the ERP intake queue.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is Live - unattended.
The source lists partial exception-reason coverage and no exported invoice linkage field.

inventory_evidence.name: PO match exception worklist
inventory_evidence.description: Builds a reviewer queue for invoices that fail two- or three-way match and attaches purchase order context.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is Pilot / UAT.
The process-owner field is blank in the source.

inventory_evidence.name: Invoice posting confirmation archive
inventory_evidence.description: Stores posting confirmations and payment-run evidence for resolved invoices.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is Retired after ERP patch.
The source does not name the replacement process.

inventory_evidence.name: Vendor onboarding request intake
inventory_evidence.description: Captures supplier requests and checks tax, banking, and contact fields before procurement review.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is Production.
The source flags bank-detail sensitivity and does not document a common case identifier.

inventory_evidence.name: Vendor risk evidence review
inventory_evidence.description: Compares submitted insurance, tax, and policy documents against onboarding requirements and routes exceptions.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is Approved backlog.
The source says document labels vary by business unit and no exception taxonomy is present.

inventory_evidence.name: Vendor master record creation
inventory_evidence.description: Creates approved supplier master records after onboarding review.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is Paused - ERP migration.
The source omits the restart date, process owner, annual volume, and write-access detail.

inventory_evidence.name: Quarterly access evidence pull
inventory_evidence.description: Extracts account and entitlement evidence for quarterly privileged-access certification.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is Deployed.
The source defines volume as entitlement lines rather than review cases.

inventory_evidence.name: Privileged access exception narrative
inventory_evidence.description: Prepares a reviewer worklist and evidence bundle for privileged-access exceptions.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is UAT.
The source says exception narratives are free text and reviewer disposition remains final.

inventory_evidence.name: Access evidence pull - legacy
inventory_evidence.description: Legacy duplicate extract retained during dashboard migration; details are no longer maintained.
facts: The raw lifecycle status marks this row as a duplicate of the quarterly access evidence pull.
The source has no owner, annual volume, or handling-time value.

inventory_evidence.name: New-hire packet completeness check
inventory_evidence.description: Checks submitted onboarding forms for required fields before HR operations review.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is Operational.
The source says packet types vary by worker class and gives no error-cost baseline.

inventory_evidence.name: Benefits life-event intake
inventory_evidence.description: Classifies incoming benefits change requests and routes incomplete submissions for follow-up.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is Idea - requested.
The source leaves the system destination and owner blank.

inventory_evidence.name: Termination checklist tracker
inventory_evidence.description: Tracks completion of offboarding checklist steps across HR, facilities, and IT.
facts: The raw lifecycle status is Cancelled.
The source attributes cancellation to a budget hold and gives no restart trigger.

public_sources.title: Synthetic Customer-Confirmed Strategy Workshop Record
public_sources.evidence_summary: The synthetic customer workshop confirms finance throughput and supplier onboarding priorities; invoice_id and supplier_request_id across frozen exports; Finance Operations Lead and Supplier Risk Lead ownership of approved historical outcomes; and available 100-case and 80-file samples after data-access approval.

public_sources.title: Synthetic Customer-Confirmed CIO Assurance Workshop Record
public_sources.evidence_summary: The synthetic customer CIO workshop confirms privileged-access evidence completeness, campaign_id and entitlement_id across frozen exports, Access Governance Manager ownership of the approved checklist and outcomes, and 120 available completed exceptions after data-access approval.

assumptions.statement: No UiPath capability entitlement has been supplied for this synthetic forward-test customer.
Deployment model, data residency, and environment connectivity remain unconfirmed beyond the stated read-only planning constraints.
The inventory omits linkage fields, but the customer workshop confirms invoice_id across frozen intake and exception exports plus Finance Operations Lead ownership of final outcomes.
The inventory omits linkage fields, but the customer workshop confirms supplier_request_id across frozen intake and risk-review exports plus Supplier Risk Lead ownership of taxonomy and outcomes.

The inventory omits linkage fields, but the customer CIO workshop confirms campaign_id and entitlement_id across frozen evidence and exception exports plus Access Governance Manager ownership of checklist and outcomes.
Onboarding and benefits requests may share one employee-service intake model, but the inventory does not establish a common owner or case boundary.
Loaded labor rates, error costs, rework rates, and validated time-savings baselines have not been supplied.
